# Section 020 Knowledge Check: Continuous Delivery With Argo CD

<!-- TODO(build): generated by /astrona-course-generate-assessment against the objectives below. Scenario questions, no recall trivia. -->

## Coverage

- Create an Application that points at a Git repository path, a target revision and a destination namespace
- Read the sync status and the health status of an Application with argocd app get and kubectl
- Turn on automated sync with prune and selfHeal and prove that a manual change in the cluster is reverted
- Tell OutOfSync from Degraded on the same Application and name which component reports each
- Register a private Git repository with a repository Secret
- Deliver a Kustomize overlay and a Helm chart through the Application source fields
- Bootstrap several Applications from one parent Application with the app of apps pattern
- Generate one Application per environment with an ApplicationSet list generator
- Generate one Application per directory with the ApplicationSet git generator
- Name and place generated Applications with Go template fields
- Restrict a tenant's source repositories and destination namespaces with an AppProject
- Read the sync result and the per-resource messages of a failed sync with argocd app get
- Find why an Application stays OutOfSync with argocd app diff and ignore a field another controller changes with ignoreDifferences
- Order dependent resources with sync waves and run a PreSync hook Job
- Diagnose a ComparisonError caused by a wrong repository URL, revision or path
- Recover a Degraded Application by fixing the Git repository instead of the cluster
